transcript: That day I hesitated in front of a small shop Should I buy the red gloves or not? It was a moment of quick decision Now I think I should have bought them I ought to have made my decision earlier in time for my sister's birthday The next day I returned, but the gloves were already gone The shopkeeper said yesterday another customer had bought them I did not confess my regret to my sister She seemed not to mind and simply smiled at me kindly Perhaps I should have been more honest But she had already forgiven me In that small moment, her maturity became clear A person may regret, yet be saved by another person's affection

segments.text: That day I hesitated in front of a small shop
Should I buy the red gloves or not?
It was a moment of quick decision
Now I think I should have bought them
I ought to have made my decision earlier in time for my sister's birthday
The next day I returned, but the gloves were already gone
The shopkeeper said yesterday another customer had bought them
I did not confess my regret to my sister
She seemed not to mind and simply smiled at me kindly
Perhaps I should have been more honest
But she had already forgiven me
In that small moment, her maturity became clear
A person may regret, yet be saved by another person's affection
